Name: Boggy Fashion Sense Mirror
Author: SugarbeeStitchery
Description:
[u][b][size=4]Overview
[/size][/b][/u]
This mod is a spin off with permission of FungiFishy's "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26661]The Witch's Magic Mirror[/url]" - but using Content Patcher, so that you don't have to drag and drop to replace the asset in your Fashion Sense folder! All mirror assets were created by them.

There are 5 colors, intended to match the different options for iridium tools from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24078]Bog's Witchy Tools[/url]. There is a simple configuration option that works with GMCM so that you can choose the color, and translation compatibility is already built in.

If you translate the mod, please let me know so that I can include the translation in the base files!

[size=4][u][b]Installation[/b][/u][/size]

Simply download the mod and extract the folder into your Mods folder!
